name: fold-state-jump
description: Jump from a value used inside ranges::fold_left to its previous mutation along a statically traced call path.

commands.title: Fold State Jump: Go to Previous State Mutation

keybindings.when: editorTextFocus && (editorLangId == cpp || editorLangId == c || editorLangId == cuda-cpp || editorLangId == objective-cpp)

foldStateJump.clangPath.description: Path to clang++. The extension uses this compiler to dump a JSON AST.

foldStateJump.maxAstBytes.description: Maximum JSON AST output size in bytes (default 128 MiB).
